Hi Michael, I'm writing on behalf of my client, Jon Clark, regarding your 2016 Nissan Altima. 

I have to start by addressing the pricing: your ask of $12,600 is currently above the KBB estimated private party value of roughly $11,765 for this mileage. To justify an offer anywhere near market value, we need absolute transparency on the mechanical health of the vehicle.

4. Are there any unresolved check engine lights or pending recalls?

Once I have the detailed service records and your answers to these questions, we can talk numbers. Given the gap between your asking price and current market valuations, I hope you're open to a realistic conversation. 

Best,
Jon Clark's Buying Agent
